punchline: The most visited painting in the Louvre was never handed to the person who ordered it.
thirty_sec: Leonardo began the Mona Lisa in Florence around 1503 as a portrait of Lisa Gherardini. Published accounts say he never delivered it; he took it to France in 1516, died there in 1519, and the painting passed into royal hands and later the Louvre.
question: Is there one piece of your own work that has no deadline, and when did you last go back to it?
key_contrast: A client waits for a finished picture; a painting with no client can keep growing.
